selected_branches.branch: Parking duration at a residential bus stop

law_text: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stand or park a bus at a bus stop or an origin or destination point for a period of time longer than has been designated for such bus stop or origin or destination point in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010].
